text: ０になれば　まけて　しまうからのう…

structure.jp: まけて　しまうからのう…
structure.en: because you end up losing, you see...

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: Changing a verb's ending to ば means 'if'. なる 'become' turns into なれば. ０になれば = 'if it becomes 0'.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: しまう after a verb's て-form says the thing happens completely, often to your regret. まけて　しまう = 'you end up losing'.

patterns.name: 〜から
patterns.explanation: から at the end of a sentence gives the reason for what was said before. のう is the old-man way of saying なあ, a soft 'you see'. しまうからのう = 'because you end up (losing), you see'.
